description: Email Qualification. Deep email deliverability verification. Performs full Email Validation plus SMTP inbox check, catch-all detection, and returns a qualification verdict (valid, invalid, risky, disposable, unknown). Credit cost: 5 credits per call.

fields.description: Comma-separated list of fields to keep in the response, with dot notation for nested fields (e.g. name,location.city). Does not change the credit cost.

query.description: The email address to qualify (e.g. john@example.com). Automatically normalized to lowercase.
